name: FEV transcription factor, ETS family member
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: FEV encodes protein FEV. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and cell differentiation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: FEV can participate in EWSR1-associated rearrangements in a subset of Ewing tumors.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-specific alteration context described by NCBI/RefSeq; variant applicability requires review.
